paragraphs.text: Dog (previously Hound ) is a creature type used for cards that depict carnivorous domestic canids closely related to the gray wolf . Their appearance is bred in many varieties. For gaming reasons, Wolves, Coyotes , Jackals , and Foxes are kept separate.
Sentient, anthropomorphic dog folk can be found on several planes, including Tarkir where they are known as aniok .
Dogs are most common in white , red , and green . However, the subtype can appear in all colors.
The first creature with the type Dog was Snow Hound in Ice Age . The first creature to bear the type Hound was Ghost Hounds in Homelands
During the Grand Creature Type Update , dogs and other creature types were changed to hound. Creature types changed to Hound include:
Dog ( Snow Hound and Zodiac Dog )
Hyena ( Gibbering Hyenas ) (later reversed in The "Grand Creature Type Update" Update)
Jackel ( Hurr Jackal and Trained Jackal ) (later reversed in Amonkhet )

Mark Rosewater previously had argued numerous times with Creative to change the Hound creature type to Dog. He argued that a hound is a type of dog much like a poodle is a type of dog. He stated that all hounds are dogs but not all dogs are hounds.
The Dog versus Hound debate was referenced earlier on the Unhinged card B-I-N-G-O and on the Mystery Booster playtest card Ruff, Underdog Champ .
In Core Set 2021 Hound was changed to Dog.

In the creature update, each Hound creature card received errata to replace that subtype with Dog. Those cards kept their other subtypes. Similarly, cards that became Hounds or created Hound tokens received errata to replace that one word with Dog. No other cards received errata to become Dogs.

There are domesticated ( Cathar's Companion , Thraben Purebloods ), elemental ( Pyre Hound , Hound of Griselbrand ), zombie ( Hound of the Farbogs , Thraben Foulbloods ), and demonic ( Dreadhound ) dogs present on the plane.
The Legion of Dusk uses dogs as camp keepers ( Encampment Keeper ).
The Emperors of Kamigawa traditionally keep and train Akita dogs. The sitting emperor 's pet dog is Yoshimaru , and in ancient times, Takeshi Konda owned a dog named Isamaru .
The plane also has living tanuki and some Kamigawan robots take inspiration from tanuki and komainu.
Cuffhounds are large canines employed by Lorwyn elven hunters as trackers and attack dogs. Cuffhounds can follow a scent for hundreds of miles.
Demonic hounds appear when Shadowmoor is an ascendance.
The Phyrexian Hollow Dogs showed up in New Phyrexia as well .
Vampire Hounds are used as watchdogs in Stronghold . Mossdog s inhabited the Skyshroud Forest .
The Boros Legion features mastiffs .
The Golgari guild of Ravnica features Mossdogs , plant hounds.
The Rakdos guild of Ravnica features elemental hounds .
Nightmare hounds live in the undercity of Ravnica .
Ainok ( 39 cards ) are sapient, humanoid Dog folk of Tarkir . Affiliated with the Abzan Houses and the Temur Frontier , they are a highly variable species, mirroring actual canine species and breeds.

Abzan ainok, resembling jackals, are the original inhabitants of the desert and experienced in sand-based magic, having taught the Abzan how to survive in the desert; they prefer to live on the fringes of human-dominated society.

Temur ainok resemble Tibetan Mastiffs. Like the Abzan Ainok, these are the original inhabitants of their environment, the Qal Sisma mountains. Eager to fight for any reason, they enjoy carnage for carnage's sake, and blood-crazed Ainok may even devour chunks of flesh from a fallen opponent, though such is considered an embarrassing lack of self-control. Well established and trusted among Temur families and sharing the same rights and responsibilities, some nonetheless feel resentment towards human domination in the clan, and the veteran Baihir Torn-Of-Ear and the semi- Mardu -affiliated Kharkhel seek to murder the khan himself to achieve dominance.
The Cerberi of Theros are two-headed ( Two-Headed Cerberus ) or three-headed ( Underworld Cerberus and Wildfire Cerberus ) dogs.
The Ghost Hounds are intangible dogs that haunt Ulgrotha in and around the Dark Barony .
Hellhound packs roam the Spikefields ( Akoum Hellhound ).
Whipsaw , Hekara 's favorite hellhound.
Karvanista ( 1 card )
G.F. Cerberus ( 3 cards )
Interceptor ( 4 cards )

Animal Sanctuary is a land that can put +1/+1 counters on dogs.
